message.content:
Sure thing! To craft a trip that feels just right for you, could you let me know a bit more about your plans?

| What I’d love to know | Why it matters |
|------------------------|----------------|
| **Length of stay** (days) | Helps me spread out activities and downtime. |
| **Travel dates / season** | Weather, crowd levels, and special events vary a lot. |
| **Budget range** (per person) | Guides accommodation, dining, and activity choices. |
| **Interests** (e.g., art, food, history, shopping, nightlife, day‑trips) | Lets me pick the sights and experiences that excite you most. |
| **Accommodation style** (hotel, boutique, Airbnb, hostels, etc.) | Ensures the vibe matches your comfort level. |
| **Transportation preferences** (public transit, bike, walking, car rental, rideshare) | Influences how we’ll get around. |
| **Any dietary or mobility considerations** | So I can recommend suitable restaurants and venues. |

Once I have those details, I’ll put together a day‑by‑day itinerary, suggest places to stay, show you the best ways to get around, and even throw in a few hidden gems that most guides miss. If you’re happy with a quick, general outline, just let me know and I’ll dive straight in!
